articles.title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial continues with psychiatrist under cross-examination
articles.description:
Dr. Jennifer Tufts testified Friday that Clancy repeatedly denied having suicidal or homicidal thoughts in the months before she killed her children and tried to take her own life.

The post Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial continues with psychiatrist under cross-examination appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Dr. Jennifer Tufts testified about Lindsay Clancy's mental state before the murders.
Clancy denied suicidal or homicidal thoughts leading up to the tragic events.
The trial's outcome may influence mental health discussions in Boston communities.
